scope: Diagnostics, calibration/probability interpretation, forgetting directions, subgroup interpretation; primary gate and complete execution/source audit belongs to parent review.

supported_observations.title: 24 captures and 18 strict decisions reproduced
supported_observations.detail: 17 未见明确迹象, 1 证据不足; 18/18 widening intervals have lower bound >0.

supported_observations.title: A-stage raw log-loss worsens on both fit and valid populations
supported_observations.detail: Strict no-clear-signal labels do not prove absence of overfitting or sound probabilities.

supported_observations.title: Calibration cannot change main MAP result
supported_observations.detail: Eight saved new calibrated score arrays exactly match positive affine transforms; all eight endpoints preserve all ranking/query columns across roles.

supported_observations.title: Raw probability quality worsens relative to corresponding S/H baseline
supported_observations.detail: Both Brier and log-loss lower bounds >0 for S_pos−S and H_pos−H in both domains; stage-cal partial improvements do not rescue ranking gate.

supported_observations.title: Old-A change and signed forgetting comparisons correctly separated
supported_observations.detail: All raw MAP old changes and forgetting contrast intervals cross zero; no confirmed catastrophe or retention improvement.

supported_observations.title: Single/double-positive grouping uses shared whole-group sampling
supported_observations.detail: 40 groups have 16/12 queries; weighted subgroup MAP identity and all 16 contrast intervals reproduced.

coverage_limits.title: Epoch 1 to 6 excludes stage-entry-to-first-epoch change
coverage_limits.action: State limitation; no new experiment or gate.

coverage_limits.title: cache/A uses six surviving training groups
coverage_limits.action: Do not equate it with all historical training or held-out performance.

coverage_limits.title: Subgroup-specific crossing of zero is not an interaction test
coverage_limits.action: Retain prespecified descriptive claim; no causal or multiple-comparison success claim.

coverage_limits.title: Saved-label-derived originals not re-created from labels
coverage_limits.action: Preserve explicit distinction between saved-value replay and source-label recomputation.
